description: D-139 marks a terminally failed pipeline run's queue job FAILED ('dead' in the core FILE job-queue). Verified read-only: apps/api/src/activity-health/queue-reader.ts reads only the MONGO upload queue (jobs collection, kind transcribe.rpc, statuses pending/processing/done/failed; only status 'failed' maps to a failure) and notifications.ts builds its items from three sources: upload-queue (that reader), provider-jobs and watcher. Neither reads packages/core job-queue; nothing in apps/api, scripts or packages imports FileJobQueue or createPipelineRunner (only pipeline-graph.test.ts uses the runner). So a runner-failed job is invisible in /system-status and notifications. Latent today because the runner is unwired.
fix_direction: A tenant-scoped reader over the file queue (dead jobs, error code, updatedAt) projected into the activity snapshot / a new notification source, once the runner is wired. Needs separate lane and approval. Not fixed in this unit by instruction.
